description: AI surveillance for 149th Rathyatra in Ahmedabad. Latest Updates. Artificial intelligence (AI) will answer police personnel, drones will scan rooftops, cameras will track crowds, and smart systems will monitor elephants in real time.
body_lead: ExclusiveAhmedabad Police goes hi-tech for 149th Rathyatra:AI telecallers, mounted CCTV surveillance, facial recognition to guard entire 14km route - Copy link Artificial intelligence (AI) will answer police personnel, drones will scan rooftops, cameras will track crowds, and smart systems will monitor elephants in real time. For the 149th Lord Jagannath Rathyatra, Ahmedabad Police has rolled out one of its most technology-driven security plans yet, blending AI-powered surveillance with thousands of personnel to secure the city’s biggest religious procession.
